supported_input: Frontal or nearly frontal visible-light slit-lamp photographs acquired with diffuse or broad-beam illumination

classes.name: background
classes.description: All pixels not assigned to a target class, including sclera, conjunctiva, surrounding skin, and image background.

classes.name: pupil
classes.description: The visible pupillary aperture bounded by the pupillary margin. Artefact pixels over the pupil receive the artefact label instead.

classes.name: iris
classes.description: Visible iris tissue from the pupillary margin to the visible limbal boundary. Do not infer iris hidden by lids, lashes, reflections, or slit-beam artefact.

classes.name: reflection
classes.description: Discrete saturated or near-saturated specular highlights that obscure underlying ocular texture.

classes.name: slit_beam
classes.description: The broad or narrow illumination band produced by the slit lamp when it obscures or materially changes iris appearance.

classes.name: eyelid
classes.description: Visible upper or lower eyelid tissue that occludes the globe or iris. Do not label all surrounding periocular skin.

classes.name: eyelash
classes.description: Individual or dense eyelashes crossing and occluding the ocular surface, iris, or pupil.

classes.name: uncertain
classes.description: Pixels that cannot be assigned confidently because the anatomical boundary or artefact type is indeterminate. Use sparingly and document the reason.
